score.description: Optional overall score for this evaluation on a numeric scale.

content.description: Evaluation data (URIs or blobs) containing detailed reports or methodology

subject.description: A strong reference to what is being evaluated (e.g. activity, measurement, contribution, etc.)

location.description: An optional reference for georeferenced evaluations. The record referenced must conform with the lexicon app.certified.location.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.

measurements.description: Optional references to the measurements that contributed to this evaluation. The record(s) referenced must conform with the lexicon org.hypercerts.context.measurement

main.description: An evaluation of a hypercert record (e.g. an activity and its impact).

max.description: Maximum value of the scale as a numeric string (e.g. '5', '10').

min.description: Minimum value of the scale as a numeric string (e.g. '0', '1').

value.description: Score within the inclusive range [min, max] as a numeric string (e.g. '3.7').

score.description: Overall score for an evaluation on a numeric scale.
